thread:
ops-bot: ALERT: p99 latency SLO breach detected on cont-batch serving path (us-west2). Metric: /v1/streaming/generate p99 = 3.4s (SLO 500ms). Paging oncall.
oncall-aly: taking pager. seen the alert, will triage now. assigning to myself and pinging runtime. @runtime-lucy can you join? :wave:
sre-ian: i'm here. checking dashboards — tail spike started ~ 00:22 UTC, correlates with increased mixed-seq traffic from a few customers. KV miss rate also up ~15%.
runtime-lucy: joining. hooking up logs. batcher queue length jumped on cont-batcher-3, pack size up to 512 for some partitions. looks like padding amplification from many short requests getting packed with very long ones.
oncall-aly: customer impact? cs-maya any active customer reports?
cs-maya: we got two support tickets flagged as 'streaming stalls' from a partner app in us-west. they report stalls ~2-3s on streaming responses. no full timeouts yet.
pm-jordan: heads-up: this customer is on Dedicated and has a tight p99 SLA. we should prioritize mitigation before escalation.
sre-ian: quick triage notes: p95 is 420ms (SLO 200ms), p99 is 3.4s. stream stall rate (stream fragments >1s gap) increased 6x. KV cache eviction spikes around same time, suggesting large batches evicting kvs.
runtime-lucy: hypothesis: continuous batching scheduler packed heterogeneous sequence-length mix which amplified padding and extended runtimes for many streams. long sequences hold the accelerator and block streaming slots.
oncall-aly: mitigation options — (1) restrict cont-batch max_batch_size for streaming route to 64 temporarily, (2) enable preemptive pack_shed to avoid long-holders, (3) route high-latency customers to fallback smaller model or dedicated pool.
oncall-aly: doing (1) and (2) now. applying quick config change to cont-batcher policy.
deploy-bot: config-change request approved. patch id: cfg-2026-03-15-842. Applying to cont-batcher pool: cont-batcher-*.us-west2. Rolling config update started.
runtime-lucy: while that's rolling, i'll enable `pack_shed_mode=preemptive` on cont-batcher-3 to drop/flush oversized packs early. command:
```
curl -X POST https://infra-api.local/batcher/config \
  -d '{"pool":"cont-batcher-3","pack_shed_mode":"preemptive","max_batch_size":64}'
```
runtime-lucy: applied to cont-batcher-3. observing logs...
ops-bot: NOTE: Automated fallback rules triggered for route /v1/streaming/generate -> fallback-model-small for 2% of traffic due to latency > 2s.
sre-ian: seeing immediate small improvement in p95, p99 trending down. p99 is now 1.2s after pack_shed change.
cs-maya: reported customer confirms partial improvement — stalls less frequent but still visible.
oncall-aly: next step: reduce mixed-seq packing policy weight and enable fairness preemption across tenants. lucy, can you switch scheduler to fairness mode for us-west?
runtime-lucy: switching scheduler mode -> `fair_share` on cont-batcher pools. command executed. rolling across nodes.
pm-jordan: also suggest temporary routing policy to steer identified heavy-seq customers to dedicated pool if available.
sre-ian: running quick query to identify top contributors to long-seq packing:
```
select tenant, count(*) as long_requests
from requests
where seq_len > 1024 and region='us-west2'
group by tenant
order by long_requests desc
limit 10;
```
sre-ian: identified three tenants responsible for ~48% of long sequences. opening action items to contact them (cs assigned) and to create long-tail handling rule.
cs-maya: will message the customers and ask for rate-limiting or optional smaller context. sending now.
oncall-aly: metrics update: after max_batch_size=64 + preemptive + fair_share + fallback routing: p95=220ms, p99=640ms. still above ideal but much better than 3.4s. stream gap events down 65%.
runtime-lucy: follow-up: we should tune `max_pack_age` as well — long sequences can still hold packs if age threshold too high. proposing `max_pack_age=12ms` from 50ms for streaming routes.
oncall-aly: agree. applying `max_pack_age=12ms` to streaming route pools.
deploy-bot: patch id cfg-2026-03-15-843 applied: max_pack_age change rolled to cont-batcher-*-streaming.
sre-ian: p99 now 420ms, p95 180ms. still slightly above target but acceptable for live mitigation. I'll keep monitoring for 30m.
pm-jordan: please file a follow-up ticket to propose durable fixes: (A) scheduler improvements for hetero sequence mixes, (B) auto-detect tenant long-seq patterns and enforce per-tenant pack caps, (C) telemetry to alert on padding amplification earlier.
oncall-aly: creating ticket INF-3241 with notes and timeline.
oncall-aly: timeline (UTC): 00:22 alert -> 00:23 pack_shed + max_batch 64 -> 00:26 fair_share + max_pack_age -> 00:30 p99 improved to 420ms.
cs-maya: customers updated: both reported better performance, one still seeing occasional 700-800ms stalls on rare requests.
runtime-lucy: we'll implement a scheduled job to rebalance long-seq tenants off shared streaming pools tomorrow and add long-seq-aware batching heuristics in the scheduler.
sre-ian: adding short-term rollback plan: if any regression after these config changes, revert `max_pack_age` and `pack_shed_mode` and route traffic to fallback-model-small while we investigate.
oncall-aly: no further immediate customer escalations. marking incident mitigated -> partial. will remain on watch for next 2h. handing over to day oncall.
ops-bot: INCIDENT: mitigated -> monitoring. Incident ID: INC-2026-1592. Pager cleared.
oncall-aly: handoff to @sre-ian for follow-up in morning. thanks all. :pray:
sre-ian: taking follow-up. filing root-cause triage doc and scheduling ops/design sync with runtime team.
pm-jordan: please include cost impact estimate for fallback routing and any Dedicated pool spin-ups in the follow-up.
cs-maya: i'll close customer loop once we have the postmortem summary.

-- end of thread --
